Rows actually visible on the free page: 5 shipment rows (2 outbound export rows to Belgium and Thailand, 3 inbound import rows from USA/China/South Korea). domestic_evidence: Screener.in consolidated financials for Sterling Tools Ltd (BSE 530759 / NSE STERTOOLS), https://www.screener.in/company/STERTOOLS/consolidated/: "Sales 1,026" Cr (Mar 2025), "828" Cr (Mar 2026), "TTM 892" Cr; latest quarter "Sales 250.35" Cr with "YoY Sales growth +20.41%"; "3 Number of manufacturing plants · Mar 2026". Business description: "manufactures cold forged, hi-tensile fasteners and supplies to all major auto OEMs across PVs, CVs, 2Ws, Construction and Farm Equipment segments" — i.e. domestic OEM supply base. Note: the annual report's explicit India-vs-export revenue split and GSTIN-level turnover were not retrieved (sterlingtools.com returned HTTP 403), so the domestic share of the ~Rs 828-1,026 Cr turnover is not quantified here.
note: HS mismatch flagged: declared HS 870899 (parts/accessories of motor vehicles) vs actual shipment HS 73181500 (threaded screws and bolts of iron/steel) — per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground; company retained, code corrected to 73181500, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Legal entity exists and is listed (BSE 530759, NSE STERTOOLS), so no rejection ground applies. Role: manufacturer (own plants, cold-forged fasteners) — not a trader. PAN AAACS0140G and Haryana state not independently verified in this pass (registry scope excluded). Export activity is factual, not merely declared: dated outbound customs lines with B/L numbers 9914069 (Belgium, 2026-02-23) and 9622669 (Thailand, 2026-02-12) under HS 73181500. Domestic supply is factual via audited-scale reported turnover and OEM supply relationships. Revenue: Rs 828 Cr FY Mar-2026 consolidated (Screener.in); export volume in USD/tonnes not public on free views — null. Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey claims 760 shipments / 26 partners; only 5 rows visible without paid access.
